commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'PID1='; ps -p 1 -o comm=
printf 'LISTENERS\n'; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'WEB_UNITS\n'; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'nginx|apache|httpd|lighttpd|caddy' || true
printf 'TOOLS\n'; command -v openssl || true; command -v nginx || true; command -v apache2 || true; command -v python3 || true
commands.error: The Antrieb managed cluster lease expired
